research.title: Research
research.intro: Three lines of work, each asking how institutions exercise authority over the people they count, admit, or process. Choose one to explore it.

count.heading: Counting and institutional authority
count.body: How official numbers are produced, contested, and carried into politics. My sole-authored paper examines the death toll of 1971 and the apology demand in Bangladesh–Pakistan relations since then.
count.diagramLabel: Illustration: bars of different lengths, like competing counts of the same event

works.title: Genocide, numbers, and memory: The death toll and the apology demand in Bangladesh–Pakistan relations since 1971

mig.heading: Migration policy and the limits of state authority
mig.body: How states organize labor migration and admission, and where their reach ends. Current work studies Bangladesh–South Korea labor cooperation beyond the Employment Permit System and compares immigration systems in the United States and Canada.
mig.diagramLabel: Illustration: two places joined by three routes; only the direct corridor passes the gate

works.title: Beyond EPS: Bangladesh–South Korea labor cooperation under demographic pressure through migration diplomacy, corridor reliability, and institutional upgrading
Comparative immigration governance in the United States and Canada

ai.heading: AI, GovTech, and public administration
ai.body: How human oversight works when government adopts automated and digital tools. I study accountability in federal AI workflows and how universities adopt new digital systems under shared decision-making.
ai.diagramLabel: Illustration: cases moving along a workflow through a human checkpoint

works.title: Speed, verification, and accountability: Human oversight beyond formal authority in federal AI workflows
Governing digital transformation under shared governance: Accountability and adoption in UIUC’s Canvas transition
A governance-ready project business case for a neurodiversity partnership with Western Illinois University

earlier.heading: Earlier work in computational text analysis
earlier.body: Before political science, I coauthored peer-reviewed work on sentiment analysis and applied machine learning, including a first-authored review of sentiment analysis datasets in *PeerJ Computer Science*. [Listed under Publications](/#publications).
